patient_journey.comment: One row per hospital admission with demographics, outcomes, risk scores and ICU exposure. Dates are de-identified and shifted per patient.

column_comments.age_at_admission: Derived: anchor_age + (admission year - anchor_year). MIMIC-IV stores no direct age.
column_comments.readmit_30d: True if the patient was readmitted within the configured window after discharge. Null for the last known admission.
column_comments.ed_boarding_hours: Hours between ED registration and ED exit, where recorded.
column_comments.drg_severity: APR-DRG severity score (1-4), higher is more severe.
column_comments.icu_hours: Total hours in ICU-type units for this admission, derived from transfers.

icu_clinical_monitoring.comment: One row per ICU stay per day: fluids, urine output, weight, procedures and ventilation. Fluid intake comes from ingredientevents (ml only).

column_comments.intake_ml: Daily fluid intake in ml from ingredientevents. Raw inputevents mixes units and is not summed here.
column_comments.net_balance_ml: intake_ml minus output_ml for the day. Negative means the patient lost more than they received.
column_comments.icu_day_number: Day of stay starting at 1, counted from the first recorded event of the stay.

hospital_pressure_daily.comment: Daily occupancy, admissions and transfer activity per care unit. Dates are per-patient shifted: compare day_of_week and is_weekend across patients, not absolute dates.

column_comments.patients_present: Distinct patients physically in the unit that day, from interval-expanded transfer segments.
column_comments.pressure_score: Project-defined z-score blend of occupancy, admissions and transfers per unit. Not a bed-capacity percentage.
column_comments.day_of_week: Preserved by the de-identification shift, safe to compare across patients.
column_comments.is_weekend: True for Saturday and Sunday. Preserved by the de-identification shift.
